# Part 1 · Section Divider

## The `.lead` layout centres vertically, stays left-aligned

---

# Two Columns Carry a Centre Rule

<div class="columns">
<div>

## Plan-driven

- Scope fixed up front
- Change is expensive
- Works when requirements are stable

</div>
<div>

## Iterative

- Scope negotiated per iteration
- Change is expected
- Works when requirements are volatile

</div>
</div>

<div class="takeaway">The choice is about <strong>volatility of requirements</strong>, not team preference.</div>

<!-- _class: large b2 -->

# The `.large` Tier for Emphasis

Body at 26px; the title stays at 42px. Use for summary slides and simple
comparisons where the audience reads from a distance.

- Fewer words per slide
- Bigger type
- One idea

---

<!-- _class: xl -->
<!-- class: "" -->

# 68%

## of projects overrun their original estimate

Hero-stat slide. The `.xl` tier puts body at 32px; the title stays at 42px.

# The `.dense` Tier for Data-Heavy Slides

<div class="columns">
<div>

## Methods

| Method | Input | Effort |
|--------|-------|--------|
| Expert judgment | Experience | Low |
| Analogy | Past project | Low |
| Planning poker | Team consensus | Medium |
| Function points | Requirements | High |
| Parametric model | Size + factors | High |

</div>
<div>

## Card tints

<div class="box">Default — green, neutral note</div>
<div class="box y">Yellow — caution</div>
<div class="box r">Red — alert or anti-pattern</div>
<div class="box n">Gray — aside</div>

<span class="chip">NEW</span><span class="chip">BETA</span>

</div>
</div>
